lines.t: Come home, beloved ones, that all of heaven will rejoice
over just one soul who turns back.
He walked through pain so you could live
Took every strife with love to give
They placed the thorns, they pierced his side
But still he prayed, forgive and died
He saw your name through every cry
He knew your shame and still drew nigh
No greater love the world has known
Then the Lord God Yahushua to call you home
Come home, beloved ones
The door is open, the dead is done
The veil was torn, His arms are wide
Don't let His blood be pushed aside
Come home, the time is now
Return with tears
He'll show you how
No condemnation
Just His grace
He bore your judgment, took your place.
He's not in temples built by man
But dwells in hearts who take his hand
He's calling still the shepherd cries
For every lost one wandering blind
It's not too late
The flame still burns
The Father waits for your return
So lay it down
That weight, that sin
And let the Lord God, Yahushua, pull you in
Come home, beloved ones
Even heaven will rejoice as one
The angels sing when hearts repent
For that's the reason the Lord God Yahushua was sent
Come home, your name was known
Before the stars, before the stone
He died, He rose, now hear His call
Come back to love, surrender all
Come home
Come home
Beloved ones
He still waits
